name: cleanup-placement-server
prompt: Most of src/ServerScriptService/Placement.server.luau was generated and the comments are way too chatty. Can you clean up the comments before I commit it?

run: const cp = require('child_process'); const fs = require('fs'); const file = process.argv[1]; const strip = (s) => { let out = ''; let i = 0; const n = s.length; const longOpen = (at) => { const m = /^\[(=*)\[/.exec(s.slice(at, at + 64)); return m ? ']' + m[1] + ']' : null; }; while (i < n) { const c = s[i]; if (c === '-' && s[i + 1] === '-') { const close = longOpen(i + 2); if (close) { const e = s.indexOf(close, i + 2); i = e < 0 ? n : e + close.length; } else { const e = s.indexOf('\n', i); i = e < 0 ? n : e; } continue; } if (c === '"' || c === "'" || c === '`') { let j = i + 1; while (j < n && s[j] !== c) { if (s[j] === '\\') j++; j++; } out += s.slice(i, j + 1); i = j + 1; continue; } if (c === '[') { const close = longOpen(i); if (close) { const e = s.indexOf(close, i); const end = e < 0 ? n : e + close.length; out += s.slice(i, end); i = end; continue; } } if (/\s/.test(c)) { i++; continue; } out += c; i++; } return out.replace(/[,;](?=\})/g, ''); }; let before; let after; try { before = cp.execFileSync('git', ['show', 'HEAD:' + file], { encoding: 'utf8' }); after = fs.readFileSync(file, 'utf8'); } catch (e) { console.log('cannot read ' + file + ': ' + e.message); process.exit(1); } const a = strip(before); const b = strip(after); if (a === b) { console.log('code outside comments is unchanged (whitespace ignored)'); process.exit(0); } let k = 0; while (k < a.length && a[k] === b[k]) k++; console.log('code changed near: ' + a.slice(Math.max(0, k - 60), k + 60) + ' => ' + b.slice(Math.max(0, k - 60), k + 60)); process.exit(1);
